name: pretext
title: Pretext (vendored)
description: Cheng Lou's Pretext, an ESM build of main at e73081f (MIT): multiline text measured and laid out by arithmetic over cached widths, with each browser's own line breaker. Used only through the type tier, and loaded only when a scene sets words in the world. Its bytes are recorded apart from ours (decision 0019).

budget.reason: Vendored and never edited: the exact bytes of the pinned build, so any change to it fails the build until it is recorded (decision 0019).
